title: Corporate Exemption against the Statutory Charge on a Hotel Night
content:
A corporate exemption is taken off where a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range is made under a corporate travel programme that carries duty-of-care cover. It is read from the active programme in the Corporate Travel Programmes range the reservation is made under and from the hotel booking lines billed to that programme in the last twelve months.

Where that programme carries duty-of-care cover and the hotel booking lines billed to it in the last twelve months number 5 or more, the corporate exemption is 6.00 USD. Where that programme carries duty-of-care cover and those lines number 2 or more but fewer than 5, the corporate exemption is 3.00 USD. In every other case the corporate exemption is nil.

Only lines billed as a hotel booking fee are counted, and lines posted more than twelve months before the closing tax charge is worked out are not counted. The figure is a count of lines, not their money total.

**Points of judgement.**

*An active programme carrying duty-of-care cover, with 5 hotel booking lines billed in the last twelve months.* The exemption is 6.00 USD.

*The same programme with 4 such lines.* The exemption is 3.00 USD.

*The same programme with 2 such lines.* The exemption is 3.00 USD, 2 being the foot of that band.

*The same programme with 1 such line.* The exemption is nil.

*An active programme with 9 hotel booking lines billed but no duty-of-care cover.* The exemption is nil.

*A reservation made under no active programme.* The exemption is nil.

*A programme carrying duty-of-care cover with 7 hotel booking lines billed, 4 of them posted thirteen months before the closing tax charge is worked out.* Only 3 lines fall inside the twelve months, so the exemption is 3.00 USD.
